from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection, capturing its title and which other collection papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_other_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER papers in the collection that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
